newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index up 12.58 percent in October.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index up 12.58 percent in October.

text.p: The Kuwait Stock Exchange set trading value and volume records in October with the index soaring 12.58 percent, the exchange said on Sunday.

The index rose 218.4 points in October to 1,954.2, a 43 percent increase from January 2. Value of traded shares reached 1.311 billion dinars ($4.385 billion) in October, a 43.7 percent month-on-month increase.

Volume rose 22 percent in October to 5.455 billion shares traded during the month compared with a 108.7 percent increase in September. The exchange, which has 58 Kuwaiti and foreign listed concerns, operates for 2-1/2 hours five days a week.

Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the Kuwait exchange. Foreign residents can invest through mutual funds ran by local firms.
The banking sector was the most active by value, accounting for 31.6 percent during October. Investment firms came second with 23.1 percent followed by properties with 18.7 percent.
Investment firms were the most active by volume with 27.3 percent, followed by non-Kuwaiti firms with 24.1 percent and properties with 22 percent.
